title: Legends: Superheroes Unlimited
description: The official superhero expansion pack for the Legends Mod.
body:
![Superheroes Unlimited](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/174e7edaf80d48363151cf3c4f4b9ac45113c7a1_0.webp)

Superheroes Unlimited is the official superhero expansion pack for the Legends Mod, bringing together an expansive collection of legendary heroes, infamous villains, iconic powers, advanced technology, and unforgettable adventures.

Suit up, harness extraordinary abilities, and forge your own legend in one of the largest superhero experiences ever created for Minecraft.

## Features
- Play as legendary heroes and villains
- Unlock unique superpowers and abilities
- Equip iconic suits and advanced technology
- Explore a growing superhero universe
- Battle powerful enemies and world-threatening foes

## Requirements
[![Legends Core](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33c52e5d76508b0a4c473bd692d17a559367ca51_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/legends-mod-core)

##
_Whether you dream of soaring through the skies, mastering incredible powers, defending the innocent, or becoming the world's greatest villain, your legend begins with Superheroes Unlimited._

**Developed by the Legends Modding Team.**
